_doc: CDD engine contract lexicon — the single vocabulary source for the command contract (C6): the harness identity set, the status-value vocab plus its dual-axis mapping, the stdout contract tokens (capsule + route anchors + the banned old-shape names), the G2 residue ban table, and the skill-anatomy schema reference. Ships to consumers via the build copy entry (dist/resources/contract-lexicon.json, same pipeline and cadence as the harness registry).
